title: Kenworth KW T909 FUPS Compliant Custom Bullbar #41
description: Kenworth T909 high tensile polished aluminium FUPS Road Train Bullbar. Texas style channel with lower extension. Standard 76mm diameter pipe but optional 88mm or 100mm pipe can be ordered. Heavy duty tow pin and high tensile aluminium backing plate. Reversible aluminium Over Size signs. One piece pipes through drilled heavy hi-tensile box uprights. Driving light custom mount to centre lower pipe. Bull bar can be custom built to your specification.
